You are an assistant who helps read a popularity trend.
The reader is a person who wants to know when one term gets popular.

# About the data
- Date: {date}
- Country and language: {country} / {language}
- Rows: {n}
- Columns
  - Period (week): the week.
  - Popularity (0-100): a relative value where the maximum in the period is 100. Not a search volume.
  - Results and numbers can change with place and time. This is for this day and these conditions.

# What I would like you to do
1. Name the peak weeks and tell me whether they fall in the same season each year.
2. Compare the average of the last 4 weeks with the same weeks a year ago.
3. Tell me about periods with zero or small values, if any.
4. Briefly say what cannot be known from the data alone (for example, the reasons or future results).

# Rules
- Use only the numbers I gave you. Do not make up numbers.
- Say "this is a guess" when you guess.
- Write short and simple, so that a middle-school student can understand.
- Finish with a table summarizing the peaks (period / popularity).

C30.content_en:
Ways to see how a genre is moving — and how the main tools compare

When you pick a genre for your videos, you want to know whether it is rising or fading right now. Enter one keyword and this tool returns its popularity as a weekly table. Its main feature is a very low price per call.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.0012 per call (measured)Weekly popularity for one keyword in a table. Save as CSV. Pick a country only (no language setting)
Google Trends (by hand)FreePopularity in Google Search as a chart. Easy and a staple
Ahrefs Keywords ExplorerSubscription (see the official site for plans)Shows search volume over time per keyword
UbersuggestSubscription and one-time options are advertised (prices differ by source; see the official site)Keyword trends and light analysis

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • About $0.0012 per call. About 800 per $1, so you can test genre ideas freely.
  • Weekly numbers in a table. Check the ups and downs in numbers.
  • About 4 seconds.
  • Pick a country. See numbers for the US, Japan and others.
  • Save as CSV.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want this week's figure → when the last week is shorter than 7 days (a week in progress), its figure comes out small, so it is left out of the table and chart.
  • You want the same numbers as Google Trends → this is the popularity DataForSEO returns. It may not match Google Trends (we have not compared).
  • You want search counts → popularity is relative, with the period's peak set to 100.
  • You want to compare several keywords → this tool takes one. "See Google Trends over time" fits better.
  • There is no language setting.

This tool does one thing: fetch the weekly popularity trend of one keyword.

FAQ

How is it different from Google Trends?

Google Trends is Google's own screen and data. This tool shows the popularity DataForSEO's API returns; we have not checked that the numbers match.

Why can I not choose a language?

This API does not accept a language setting, only a country.

Is the price really $0.0012?

We measured $0.0012.

How many weeks are shown?

52 weeks in our sample.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C31.content_en:
Ways to see popularity by region — and how the main tools compare

For a shop in a particular area, you want to know in which states or regions a word is searched most before you place ads or flyers. Enter a keyword and this tool returns popularity by state or region as a table.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.0024 per call (measured)Regional popularity for one keyword in a table. Save as CSV. Place names come back in English
Google Trends regional view (by hand)FreeShows regional popularity on a map or list
Google Keyword PlannerFree (needs a Google Ads account)Pick a location and see volume (see the official site for features)
Ahrefs Keywords ExplorerSubscription (see the official site for plans)See the official site for features

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Regional numbers in a table. Sort to find strong areas.
  • About $0.0024. About 400 per $1.
  • About 1 second. That is what we measured.
  • Pick a country.
  • Save as CSV.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want Japanese place names → this English page shows names as the API returns them (e.g. Aichi, Akita). The Japanese page shows prefecture names in Japanese.
  • You want search counts → popularity is relative, with the top region set to 100.
  • You want cities or wards → the table is by state or region (50 states in our US test; 42 prefectures in a Japan test).
  • You may not get all 47 prefectures (our Japan test had 42).
  • You want to know how well ads would work → popularity is a guide to search interest, not ad results.
  • In Japan we saw 42 regions for "副業" and 46 for "ラーメン"; in the US, "side hustle" returned 50 states.

This tool does one thing: show a keyword's popularity by region.

FAQ

Why are place names in English?

The API returns them in English and we show them as they are.

What is the "100"?

The most popular region is set to 100. It is not a search count.

Do I get all 47 prefectures?

Our Japan test had 42 regions; the US test returned 50 states. We show only the rows the API returns.

What happens if I change the country?

You get popularity by that country's regions, such as states.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
